verdict.rationale: Devin ships built-in event-triggered automation. Devin Review runs automatic first-pass reviews on pull requests, and Auto-Fix, once enabled, automatically responds to review comments and CI failures. These are fixed, vendor-defined behaviors that are switched on, not a general facility for users to author their own event→action rules; scheduling is time-based rather than event-based, and CI/CD integration relies on the user's own pipeline. Missing for 10: user-authored rule definitions (custom triggers, conditions, actions), a documented event catalog beyond PR reviews and CI, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: With Auto-Fix enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
